reference_anchors: <Video 1> supplies the performer's identity and dress, her exact action and timing (walk forward with a leftward glance from 0–5s, then turn to face the camera with a growing smile, slow down and extend her right hand toward the lens from 5–9.5s), the locked-off camera and framing change caused by her approach, and the uniform green-screen region to be removed.

<Video 2> supplies the replacement environment: mossy green floor densely set with small mushrooms, red berries and tiny glowing points, the large red amanita with visible gills on the left, dark cave backdrop with vertical waterfall-like light bands, saturated mossy green with red-orange accents against cool dark depth, warm local foreground glow with low-contrast cool background light, soft bloom and thin haze.
open_design: Exact frame-level timing of the environment glow, motes and berry brightness relative to her steps and reach.
Content of the continuous continuation after the 9.5-second source ends: the bloom around her hand, the creature's reaction and the settled final glow.
Whether the small creature from video 2 is kept as a small off-centre background element.
All ambience and score, since no audio was analysed for either asset.

content_events.text: Remove the uniform green-screen background behind the performer across the whole clip and eliminate green spill on her hair and edges, replacing the region with the fairy-tale forest.

Fill the replaced background with video 2's fairy-tale environment: mossy ground with dense small mushrooms, red berries and small glowing points, the large red amanita with visible gills at the left, dark cave backdrop with vertical waterfall-like light bands, saturated green with red-orange accents and cool dark depth.
Keep the performer's identity, face, curly auburn hair, cream vintage dress and body appearance unchanged.

Keep the performer's action, pose and timing: she walks toward the locked camera glancing left (0–5s), turns to the camera with a growing smile, then slows and extends her right hand toward the lens (5–9.5s).
Make background elements move in sync with her action and timing while staying spatially locked to her, so the light, motes and berries respond to her steps and to her reaching hand.
Replace the performer's lighting so its direction, color temperature, intensity and shadows match the replacement background.
Run 15 seconds continuously and end in a settled, resolved state.

editing_treatments.text: Keep the source's single continuous locked-off take: no cuts, no transitions and no added camera movement, so the keyed performer stays registered to the new background.
Deliver a clean composite with no green fringe, green spill, matte edge or interface overlay visible at any time.

global_style.text: Fairy-tale storybook realism: high-saturation mossy greens with red-orange accents against a cool dark background, warm foreground glow, soft bloom, thin haze and slowly drifting glowing motes.

audio_requirements.text: Generate audio: a quiet enchanted-forest ambience and a light storybook score, since no source audio is available to reuse.
No dialogue and no lyrics; the performer's lips part into a smile without spoken words.

developments.visible_change: The girl walks forward across the mossy forest floor toward the locked lens and glances to her left, her dress swaying, while the moss glow and glowing motes brighten and drift upward in step with her steps and the small creature lifts its head and turns toward her; she then turns to face the camera with a growing smile as the framing tightens from full body to medium shot.
developments.outcome: She stands facing the camera in a medium shot, smiling, keyed clean of the green screen, lit by a warm key with a cool rim, with the fairy-tale forest glowing around her.

developments.visible_change: She slows and extends her right hand toward the lens; glowing motes stream across the moss and gather into her open palm, the red amanita and berries brighten, and her face and dress take the warmer key as her lips part into a wide smile aimed at the lens without spoken words.
developments.outcome: Her right hand is extended toward the lens with the motes gathered in her palm, the forest light raised around her.

developments.visible_change: Completing the reach and continuing past the end of the source footage, the motes lift off her palm and swirl up around her hand into the air; the whole forest floor blooms brighter with a gentle pulse from the light bands behind and the creature stands and faces her; she draws her hand back to her chest, keeps smiling at the camera, and the light settles into a calm steady warm glow over the unchanged cool bands.
developments.outcome: The video ends with her facing the camera, hand near her chest, the forest glow settled and the cool vertical light bands steady behind her.

shots.content_purpose: Execute the entire background-replacement edit in one continuous locked-off take: the keyed performer's walk, turn and right-hand reach with light and motes synchronized to her action and timing, then the bloom around her hand and the settled final glow.
shots.description: The shot begins from the same framing as <Video 1>: <Subject 1> stands full body at the centre of frame with her flat shoes on the mossy floor of <Subject 2>, the large red amanita with visible gills rising on the left, dense small mushrooms, red berries and tiny glowing points spread across the moss around her, <Subject 3> sitting quietly on the moss to the right of her, and the dark cave wall with its vertical waterfall-like light bands filling the depth behind. She carries a warm soft key from the front left that matches the amanita glow, a cool rim from the light bands behind that separates her from the dark background, and a soft warm contact shadow under her feet. In the first five seconds she walks forward toward the lens and glances to her left, her dress swaying, while the moss glow and the glowing motes brighten and drift upward in step with her steps and the small creature lifts its head and turns toward her; she then turns to face the camera with a growing smile, the framing tightening from full body to medium shot as she approaches. From about five seconds she slows and extends her right hand toward the lens, and the glowing motes stream across the moss and gather into her open palm, the red amanita and berries brightening as her face and dress pick up the warmer key; her lips part into a wide delighted smile at the lens with no spoken words. Past the end of the source footage she completes the reach, the motes lift off her palm, swirl up around her hand and rise into the air, the whole forest floor blooms brighter as the light bands behind pulse gently and the creature stands and faces her. She draws her hand back to her chest, holds her smile toward the camera, and the light settles into a calm steady warm glow on her while the cool vertical bands behind stay steady to the final frame. The camera remains a locked static shot throughout so she stays registered to the background, her footsteps press softly into the moss, a single clear chime sounds as the motes gather in her hand, and the low cave murmur swells slightly with the bloom and eases back as the glow settles.

uncertainties: <Video 1> runs 9.5 seconds while the target duration is 15 seconds: the first 9.5 seconds reuse the source action and timing one-to-one and the remaining roughly 5.5 seconds extend the same performance and environment; if the source must not be extended, the target should be 9.5 seconds instead.
No audio was analysed for video 1 or video 2, so all ambience and score are newly designed and no source audio, dialogue or lyrics are claimed or reused.
The white cursor visible in video 2 is treated as recording-interface residue and excluded from the transferred background.
The user did not specify whether video 2's central creature should be kept; it is retained only as a small off-centre background element so it cannot compete with the performer.
The replacement background's exact lighting parameters are inferred from video 2's visible warm foreground glow and cool low-contrast background light rather than measured values.
